illusts.title: Au ra Sickle Decapitation
illusts.caption:
Rui decided to challenge Kida, thinking because she was shy, she'd be weak. It was a mistake she'd regret.

Immediately when the fight began, Kida wasted no time attacking. Rui started to move forward, but Kida was way too fast for her to properly react, and before she knew it, Kida's sickles had already sliced straight through her neck. Rui slightly leaned back as she continued moving, and her head completely slid off. It was a clean cut. Rui's now headless corpse fell to its knees, resting there for a moment before immediately collapsing. The girl's severed head falling behind the corpse, and rolling closer to Kida's feet. Kida was posing dramatically as Rui's headless corpse fell. It was the cleanest decapitation she had performed to date. She quickly hurried out of the arena afterwards, dragging Rui's severed head and headless corpse along with her.
